children: Asana reported second quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $216.4 million, up 10% year over year, and non-GAAP operating income of $21.8 million (10% margin). GAAP net loss narrowed to $39.2 million ($0.17 per share) while non-GAAP net income was $23.8 million ($0.10 diluted). The company raised its full-year revenue and non-GAAP operating margin guidance and provided Q3 and full fiscal 2027 outlook ranges.
Revenue: $216.4 million for Q2 FY2027, up 10% year over year.
Gross profit: $186.1 million for Q2 FY2027; GAAP gross margin 86.0% (non‑GAAP gross margin 87.2%).
Operating income: GAAP operating loss $41.2 million (‑19% of revenue); non‑GAAP operating income $21.8 million (10.1% margin).
Net income: GAAP net loss $39.2 million ($0.17 per share); non‑GAAP net income $23.8 million ($0.10 diluted net income per share).
Cash flow and liquidity: Net cash provided by operating activities $46.0 million; adjusted free cash flow $42.3 million for the quarter.
Customer growth and retention: Core customers (≥$5,000 ARR) reached 26,778, up 7% year over year; customers spending ≥$100,000 ARR increased to 890, up 16% year over year.
Dollar-based net retention: Overall NRR improved to 97%; NRR for Core and ≥$100k cohorts was 98%.

Product and platform initiatives: Launched the operating system for human-agent teams with Agentic Work Management, and announced Agentic Applications including Asana Service Management, Command by Asana, and Asana Client Management.

AI and M&A: Reported momentum in AI products (AI Studio, AI Teammates, Asana Dash) and completed acquisition of StackAI to extend execution of AI agents across CRMs, ERPs, and enterprise infrastructure.
Security and market validation: Achieved FedRAMP Moderate authorization for Asana Gov and received recognition in Gartner and S&P Global/451 Research for agent-builder and product positioning.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Asana posts Q2 FY2027 revenue $216.4M, non-GAAP operating margin 10% and raises full-year guidance
